data.gender_notes: Joab is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Joab is recorded in name-lists as “Given by God”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Joab expresses “Given by God”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Joab total 10, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: יוֹאָב
in_hebrew.meaning: יוֹאָב הוּא שֵׁם הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה וְהוּא יוֹאָב בֶּן-צְרוּיָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יוֹאָב הוּא שֵׁם הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה וְהוּא יוֹאָב בֶּן-צְרוּיָה, מְשַׁמֵשׁ כְּקָצִין צְבָאִי לְדָוִד מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל, וּמִשְׁפַּחַת הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַכֹּהֲנִים

in_greek.name: Ιωάβ
in_greek.meaning: Ιωάβ σημαίνει Θεός πατήρ ή ο Θεός είναι πατέρας μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Ιωάβ σημαίνει Θεός πατήρ ή ο Θεός είναι πατέρας μου, ήταν ο υιός της Σερουΐας και αδελφός του Αβισσαί και του Ασαιήλ, και διετέλεσε ως στρατηγός του Δαβίδ

in_latin.name: Joab
in_latin.meaning: Joab means God is father or God the Father
in_latin.long_meaning: Joab means God is father or God the Father, was a military commander under King David, and brother of Abishai and Asahel, played a significant role in Israel's history
